allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Further to our intimations dated May 19, 2025 and August 28, 2025, regarding allotment of 17,60,000 equity shares of Rs. 10/- per equity shares of Amplus Ampere Private Limited ( Amplus ), we wish to inform you that the Company has transferred /disinvested 17,59,999 equity shares of Rs 10/- each (3.12%) for a consideration of Rs. 1,75,99,990/- to Amplus Energy Solutions PTE Ltd, on January 20, 2026 as per the terms contained in Share Subscription and Shareholders Agreement to maintain compliance with Group Captive norms. Kindly note that Amplus Energy Solutions PTE Ltd is not a related party.
